notes:
A new look for the whole app: every screen has been redesigned to match the new web portal — figure cards at the top of lists (tap one to filter), one search-and-filter bar, cleaner cards with status colours, lists grouped by day, and icon buttons for quick actions. Long explanation text has been removed so screens show only what matters.

Rewards & Recognition: award categories are now set by HR and Admin, with Best Employee always at the top.

Events: a Super Admin can see who added each event, on the Events page and in the Calendar.
